cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo && git update-ref -d refs/remotes/origin/main 2>/dev/null; git fetch -q origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main
for f in live_web.py index.html; do git show origin/main:bot/live/$f > /tmp/lv_$f || exit 1; done
/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile /tmp/lv_live_web.py || { echo COMPILE_FAIL; exit 1; }
cp /opt/trading-bot/live/live_web.py /tmp/live_web.bak; cp /opt/trading-bot/live/index.html /tmp/index.bak
install -o tbot -g tbot -m 644 /tmp/lv_live_web.py /opt/trading-bot/live/live_web.py; install -o tbot -g tbot -m 644 /tmp/lv_index.html /opt/trading-bot/live/index.html
U=/etc/systemd/system/live-web.service
grep -q LIVE_CTL_PORT $U || sed -i 's#^Environment=LIVE_PORT=18110#Environment=LIVE_PORT=18110\nEnvironment=LIVE_CTL_PORT=18111#' $U
grep -q ReadWritePaths $U || sed -i 's#^PrivateTmp=true#PrivateTmp=true\nReadWritePaths=/opt/trading-bot/live#' $U
systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl restart live-web; sleep 6
echo "svc=$(systemctl is-active live-web) public=$(curl -s -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:18110/live/health) ctl=$(curl -s -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:18111/live/health)"
ss -ltn | grep -E ':1811[01] ' | awk '{print "listen",$4}'
echo "page_via_caddy=$(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --resolve 130-61-25-212.nip.io:443:127.0.0.1 https://130-61-25-212.nip.io/live/)"
/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import json, urllib.request
env = {}
for l in open("/opt/trading-bot/tg.env", encoding="utf-8"):
    l = l.strip()
    if l and not l.startswith("#") and "=" in l:
        k, v = l.split("=", 1); env[k.strip()] = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
tok = open("/opt/trading-bot/live/token.txt").read().strip()
txt = '\u0423\u043f\u0440\u0430\u0432\u043b\u0435\u043d\u0438\u0435 \u0433\u0440\u0430\u0444\u0438\u043a\u043e\u043c (\u0447\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0437 \u0442\u0443\u043d\u043d\u0435\u043b\u044c Termux).\n1) \u0412 Termux: ssh -N -L 18111:127.0.0.1:18111 <\u0442\u0432\u043e\u0439 \u0432\u0445\u043e\u0434 \u043d\u0430 VPS>\n2) \u0412 \u0431\u0440\u0430\u0443\u0437\u0435\u0440\u0435 \u0442\u0435\u043b\u0435\u0444\u043e\u043d\u0430 \u043e\u0442\u043a\u0440\u043e\u0435\u0442\u0441\u044f: http://127.0.0.1:18111/live/#t=' + tok + '\n\u0421\u0441\u044b\u043b\u043a\u0443 \u043d\u0438\u043a\u043e\u043c\u0443 \u043d\u0435 \u043f\u043e\u043a\u0430\u0437\u044b\u0432\u0430\u0439.'
r = urllib.request.Request("https://api.telegram.org/bot%s/sendMessage" % env["TG_TOKEN"], data=json.dumps({"chat_id": int(env["TG_USER_ID"]), "text": txt, "disable_web_page_preview": True}).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
print("MSG ok=%s" % json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=20)).get("ok"))
EOF
journalctl -u live-web -n 4 --no-pager | cut -c1-150
